learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn how to join our ideas using smart connecting words for reasons, results, and conditions!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We use 'Because' to give a reason. We use 'So' and 'Therefore' to show the result. Example: I was very tired, so I went to sleep.
These words connect two opposite or surprising ideas. Example: Although it was raining heavily, we played outside!
We use 'If' when one thing depends on another thing happening first. Example: If you study hard, you will definitely get good grades.

fun_activity.title: 🪢 Match the Sentence
fun_activity.instructions: Say a sentence using 'Because' (e.g., I am happy because...). Ask your sibling or friend to finish the sentence!

quick_recap: ⭐ Conjunctions are joining words that connect sentences and ideas together smoothly.
⭐ Use 'Because' to explain reasons, and 'So' or 'Therefore' to show results.
⭐ Use 'Although' or 'Though' to connect two surprising or opposite ideas.
